name: prescription-grounding
claim: A prescription is adopted: every active prescription grounds in deps (the beliefs it rests on) or in a stipulation artifact citing plan:, user:, session:, or document: - the record of the adoption event. External-source schemes never ground a prescription.

rules.given: An active prescription with non-empty deps
rules.then: The prescription is grounded - it rests on the beliefs it cites

rules.given: An active prescription with empty deps
rules.then: The artifact must carry a stipulation scheme (plan:, user:, session:, document:) recording where the prescription was adopted

invariants: For all active prescriptions d: deps(d) non-empty OR scheme(d.artifact) in {plan, user, session, document}
Stipulation schemes are a closed set: plan | user | session | document
External-source schemes (source, https, gmail) never ground a prescription

evidence.detail: D4 confirmed, with the execution amendment admitting document: - the design's own worked re-homes (method:a1-a5, the lib: rules) are document-grounded stipulations. Legitimizes conventions as directives without manufacturing fake deps.

Standalone-contract carve-out collapsed by user decision (option a of the contract-predicate-demotion seed): with contract-grade demoted to a derived predicate, 'may stand alone if it carries rules' conflated internal structure with provenance. Every active prescription now grounds in deps or a stipulation artifact. Measured at execution: 20 of 21 active contracts already complied; cb:b046 gained its adoption record.
